info.title: Texas Legislature Universal API
info.description: Access public Texas Legislature Online legislative activity RSS feeds and official TLC bulk-file guidance for bill text, analyses, fiscal notes, reports, witness lists, and bill history XML.

get.summary: Get Today's Bill Analyses RSS Feed
get.description: Retrieves today's bill analyses from Texas Legislature.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

link.description: URL linked by the RSS item.

pubDate.description: RSS item publication date when present.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
